temporal_display.method: Cross-dissolve saved raster states, no particle-coordinate interpolation
temporal_display.count_label: Largest group of the most recent saved state; not an interpolated count

aggregation_display.representation: One blue shaded sphere per active physical particle, no ring glyphs or synthetic packing
aggregation_display.transform: X_display = cluster_centroid + scale * (X_real - cluster_centroid); R_display = scale * R_real
aggregation_display.true_geometry: Actual saved group membership, centroid, orientation and every distance/radius ratio preserved
aggregation_display.scope: In-place magnified cluster geometry is a display glyph, not millimetre-scale physical extent. Overlap between distinct magnified groups is display occlusion, not simulated contact.

field.slices: Native XY z=0 and YZ x=0

science_scope: Sealed Stage 4I B2/B3 only. Existing near-contact, near-wall and finite-Re limits remain.
